must: Keep map overlays compact and readable over every basemap style
Preserve keyboard focus, aria labels, and mobile touch targets
avoid: Decorative gradients and excessive glass effects
Controls that obscure price markers or the time slider

decisions.decision: Superseded: the initial OpenFreeMap style switcher established the compact three-option control pattern later retained for NAVER Maps.
Raise supporting copy to at least 11px, body controls to at least 12px, and render map labels in Korean-first single-language form with a stronger halo.
Use NAVER Maps GL vector map as the primary basemap and expose Normal, Terrain, and Hybrid map types while preserving product overlays.

Use white price chips with a restrained brand status dot for observed trades; render unpriced catalog apartments as compact neutral dots that expand on selection, and cluster dense views into circular count markers.
